notes.title: Hotfix 02
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a QoL setting that unlatches wall hangs when not pressing any direction (thanks Danny Tanner for the suggestion).
[*] Added leadboard refresh button and attempted to fix leaderboards not loading correctly.
[*] Reshuffled the music of the first 6 layers to make it more interesting.
[/list]

notes.title: Game is out now!!!
notes.notes: Playing God is finally here! To celebrate this, we are having a launch discount of 10% off from now till 7th of December 2024! Check this game out if you are a fan of precision platformers and speedrunning. Do you have what it takes to escape Hell?

notes.title: Playing God will be coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
The demo of Playing God will be available in Steam Next Fest 2024 starting [b]TOMORROW[/b] 14 October at 05:00 pm (GMT). To prepare for the event, we have a new update!

-RATH

Demo update changes below:
[list]
[*] added casual difficulty mode
[*] added intro cutscene
[*] optimised deadzone for controller input
[*] fixed some audio bugs
[*] fixed some leaderboard display bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is Out NOW!
notes.notes:
The demo for PLAYING GOD is out now! Download and try your hand at this ultrafast speedrunning platformer!

Look for the "Download Demo" button on the Steam store page to play it.
